input.title: Tapping daily reminder push notification should open composer with draft ready
input.description:
In the Talk to Me app, the daily reminder push notification currently supports two interaction paths:
1. Tap-and-hold on the notification (works well) — lets user reply inline right from the notification without opening the app.
2. Plain tap on the notification (broken UX) — currently just opens the app to the home screen with no link to the daily prompt; user has to manually hunt for it.

Requested behavior for plain tap:
- Tapping (not holding) the daily reminder notification should deep-link into the app directly into the "new message" / reply composer for that day's prompt.
- The composer should be pre-populated/queued with the same image/content that was in the push notification (the daily prompt image).
- The text input box should be focused and ready for the user to type their response immediately.
- User should be able to type their message and hit send to complete the flow without extra navigation steps.

Additional nice-to-have (secondary, can be a follow-up but include if scoped together):
- Add a floating banner/card on the home screen showing "today's daily thought" with the prompt text/image.
- Tapping this home screen banner should also open the reply/composer flow for that day's prompt, same as the notification tap-through.

Acceptance criteria:
- Plain tap on daily reminder push notification opens the app directly to the reply composer for that day's prompt (not just the home screen).
- The composer shows the daily prompt's image/content and has the text input focused.
- User can type and send a reply directly from this deep-linked screen.
- (Stretch) Home screen shows a persistent banner/card for today's daily thought that opens the same composer flow when tapped.

Source: Telegram intake.
